goals.detail: Goal! Everton 0, Chelsea 1. Pedro Neto (Chelsea) clinical left-footed shot. Assisted by Jorrel Hato with a through ball.
Goal! Everton 0, Chelsea 2. Pedro Neto (Chelsea) finishes low into the bottom right corner after Cole Palmer's free kick rebound.
